archetype: ARCHETYPE 2: THE PERFORMANCE PRO & TACTICAL CRAFTSMAN (Electrician / Impianti Elettrici)
design_rationale: For an Italian professional electrician managing active jobs, materials stock, and client quotes (preventivi), the interface fuses tactical command-center precision (deep obsidian surfaces with high-visibility amber/copper wire volt accents) with mobile-first responsive architecture tailored for on-site operation from a smartphone or tablet. Number/date formats strictly follow Italian conventions (dd/MM/yyyy, € 1.250,00).

mobile_first_strategy.touch_targets: Minimum 48px height on interactive buttons and inputs for easy one-handed thumb navigation on mobile devices on job sites.
mobile_first_strategy.bottom_navigation: Sticky bottom bar on mobile (<768px) with quick access to Dashboard, Lavori, Materiali, Preventivi, and prominent '+' FAB for adding jobs/materials on the fly.
mobile_first_strategy.responsive_tables: Tables transform into touch-friendly cards on mobile viewports with quick action drawers.
mobile_first_strategy.quick_actions: One-tap direct calling (tel: link) and WhatsApp messaging for client contacts.

rules.labels: font-sans uppercase text-xs tracking-wider font-semibold text-slate-400

entry_surfaces./: High-density dark command center dashboard with electric volt accents: KPI metric tiles at top, active lavori cards in center, pending preventivi ledger on right, and low-stock alerts panel with mobile bottom nav.
entry_surfaces./lavori: Filterable kanban and mobile-card / data table view of electrical jobs with client contact fast-dial/WhatsApp links, real-time status switches, linked materials used, and total billing.
entry_surfaces./materiali: Inventory & catalogue workstation with instant search, category filtering (Cavi, Magnetotermici, Prese/Interruttori, Canaline, Quadri, Illuminazione), low-stock warning chips, unit pricing, and quick in/out adjustments.
entry_surfaces./preventivi: List of quotes with status badges, client name, expiration, and total value with quick actions (duplica, crea lavoro da preventivo, stampa/PDF).
entry_surfaces./preventivi/nuovo: Interactive Quote Builder studio with customer info, dynamic line items for materials (auto-completes from catalogue) + labor hours (tariffa oraria), auto-calculated IVA and totals, with live PDF preview pane.
entry_surfaces./preventivi/:id: Detailed printable and exportable quote sheet with electrician business header, breakdown tables, terms of payment, and digital approval status.

visual_enhancers.tactical_borders: 1px border with border-slate-800/80 and subtle inner highlight for sharp hardware feel
visual_enhancers.copper_glow: shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(245,158,11,0.15)] on active cards and primary CTA buttons
visual_enhancers.print_media_css: @media print { body { background: white !important; color: black !important; } .no-print { display: none !important; } .print-only { display: block !important; } }
visual_enhancers.voltage_iconography: Zap, Wrench, ShieldCheck, Box, FileText, Plus, Calculator, Phone, MapPin, CheckCircle2, Clock, Euro, MessageCircle

fields: categoria (Cavi e Conduttori, Magnetotermici e Quadri, Prese e Interruttori, Tubi e Canaline, Illuminazione, Minuteria e Fissaggi)
voci_materiali [{materiale_id, nome, quantita, unita, prezzo_unitario, subtotale}]

testing_attributes.rule: Every button, input, tab, select, modal trigger, card, and actionable row MUST have a distinct data-testid.

instructions_to_main_agent: Language is strictly Italian throughout all UI labels, form fields, table headers, toasts, and seed data.
Currency formatting: standard Italian euro display (e.g. '1.250,00 €' or '€ 1.250,00'). Date format: DD/MM/YYYY.
Mobile-first responsive design: ensure all modals, forms, and lists render cleanly on narrow screens (375px - 425px) with comfortable tap targets and sticky action bars.

In backend/seed.py, seed realistic electrician data: 5-8 common electrical jobs (e.g. 'Rifacimento impianto appartamento Via Roma', 'Installazione Wallbox ricarica auto', 'Sostituzione quadro salvavita con magnetotermici differenziali'), 15-20 common Italian electrical materials (BTicino Living Now prese, interruttori bipolari, cavo FS18 3G2.5, differenziale Gewiss 25A 30mA, tubi corrugati, faretti LED), and 4-6 realistic quotes in various statuses.
Implement 'Crea Lavoro da Preventivo': when a quote is marked accepted, one click creates a corresponding Job pre-populated with client info and allocated materials.
Provide Material Stock adjustment dialog and 'Registra Materiali Usati nel Lavoro' so the electrician can log actual cables/switches used on a job site directly from their phone.
Ensure the printable view for quotes is clean, elegant, and ready for browser printing/PDF save with professional electrician company header.
